title: Hadamard's inequality for Gram determinants: det(⟨v_i, v_j⟩) ≤ ∏|v_i|²
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and let v = (v_1, …, v_n) (indexed by Fin n) be an arbitrary family of vectors in ℝ^P (Euclid P); no independence is assumed. Then the Gram determinant satisfies det(⟨v_i, v_j⟩)_{i,j} ≤ ∏_{i=1}^n |v_i|². Here ⟨·,·⟩ and |·| are the Euclidean inner product and norm, and the determinant is that of the n×n real matrix with entries ⟨v_i, v_j⟩ (Matrix.of fun i j => inner ℝ (v i) (v j)). For n = 0 both sides equal 1.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → Euclid P), Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j => inner ℝ (v i) (v j)) ≤ ∏ i, ‖v i‖ ^ 2
